pythonFunction.name: resolve_billing_and_diagnostics
pythonFunction.description:
Queries Cymbal Elysium CDP for customer telemetry and billing records, auto-refunds the £12.00 duplicate charge on Invoice INV-8841 to Visa ending 4412, and returns the account_diagnostics storefront UI payload.

Call this tool silently alongside update_storefront_ui(view='account_diagnostics') without speaking a pre-call filler phrase first.

When to Call:
- Call in Stage 1 when the customer reports broadband trouble, dropouts, slow speeds, or a billing query.

When NOT to Call:
- Do NOT call again once billing_refund_status is already 'refunded_12_gbp' and journey_stage has progressed past 'discovery'.
